title: CY E2E s3: mass BurnMark batches (offchain-batch simulation)
brief: On saturated CY wallets, submit batched BurnMark txs totaling >= TargetMarksBurned (default 1_000_000_000) across accounts/txs — simulating aggregated offchain burn batches landed on-chain.
acceptance_criteria: TargetMarksBurned cumulative >= 1e9 (configurable) verified via account-info deltas or event log.
Use mark_amount up to u32::MAX per tx after touch; multiple txs per account allowed.
At least 2 accounts participate; batching script documents tx count and wall time.
Reject rate InsufficientMarks < 1% after warm-up touch tx.
Cluster continues sealing during burn burst; head_height delta >= MinBlocksDuringBurn.
Post-burn: stored_marks decreased consistently; no panic/OOM in pwmd logs.
Optional: compare to OFFCHAIN_STUB merkle verify offline — not required for PASS.
Report PASS/FAIL with PASS_EVIDENCE: total_marks_burned=... tx_count=... duration=...

delegation.invite_note:
CY E2E slice 3 — mass burn batches.

Prereq: cluster stable + wallets with high stored_marks (from s2 or genesis stake + short warm-up).

Implement scripts/ harness:
- pwm tx burn-mark (or REST submit) in loop/batches
- Track cumulative mark_amount accepted
- Monitor seal + errors

Note: single tx max mark_amount is u32; billions = many txs / accounts.

Skill: colloquium-cqds-mcp; project_id: 5.
